areas.t: Friday Afternoon Update: As of 2:45pm Friday, hourly air quality values for fine particulate matter (PM2.5) are in the good range, but the moderate range was seen for a few hours earlier this morning. High pressure continues to bring quiet weather, and the stagnant air is allowing PM2.5 to build up
